whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.description: Deep Roots is a decentralized ecosystem powered by blockchain, AI, and the people who believe in building a freer, fairer digital world.

whatDrivesUs.heading: What Drives Us
whatDrivesUs.description: We believe the internet’s future belongs to its users not platforms. We’re here to build that future, from the ground up.

whatWeAreBuilding.heading: What We’re Building
whatWeAreBuilding.intro: We’re building an ecosystem of over 20 products all connected by one chain, one token, and one mission:

whoBuildsIt.heading: Who Builds It
items: Backed by community, not VC control
whoBuildsIt.footer: We don’t just build tech. We build tools for generations.

ourMission.title: From World To DeWorld
ourMission.line1: We call our mission DeWorld - the shift from centralized control to a decentralized digital reality.
ourMission.line2: This isn’t a brand project. It’s a root system for the new internet.
ourMission.footer: We seed visions in the earth’s roots and harvest deep solutions for life.
